svg.text: GitGalaxy Structural Extraction: Tri-Comparison vs. Tree-sitter and ctags
No tool is ground truth -- each bar is that tool's own agreement rate vs. everything anyone found.
Bar groups vary 1-3 by language's tool coverage -- order is always GitGalaxy, tree-sitter, ctags.
GitGalaxy's bar is GRAY when beaten and unaudited, colored when tied or validated.
See docs/self_scan/how_to_investigate_a_discrepancy.md for what an unaudited gap means.
Value labels are raw counts (matched/total). Regenerate: tri_comparison_chart.py --all --write
